messages:
Maria G.: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard lyra-7b into the model catalog and pin v1 for staging today. Target deploy 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC. Alex to do the pin. CI is green on PR #4821. Who can join a 30m smoke window? :eyes:
Alex Chen: I can run the deploy. I'll be online from 13:50->15:00 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/4821. I want someone to run perf+quality smoke and to confirm rollback steps before we start.
Priya Iyer: I can take smoke tests. I'll validate generation quality (nucleus @0.95, temp 0.2), latency P50/P95, and memory. Targets: P50 < 120ms for 1k tokens sample, GPU mem < 40GB. I'll use the smoke script below.
Priya Iyer: ```bash
# run quick smoke against staging canary
export KEY=$REDWOOD_STAGING_KEY
python smoke_runs.py --endpoint https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate --model lyra-7b-v1 --samples 50 --prompt-set smoke_prompts/lyra_smoke.json
```
Theo Park: I'll monitor canary dashboards and tracing. Plan: 2% canary for 10m, if OK -> 20% for 15m -> full. Fallback policy: immediate revert to phoenix-4b-pin-20260301 if error rate > 1% or latency jump > 2x.
SRE Oncall: I'm oncall during that window. I'll keep infra alerts set: error-rate > 0.8% (pager), GPU OOM > 0 (pager), and region-wide latency anomalies. Tag me @channel if anything looks off.
Alex Chen: Deploy plan summary:
1) Lock catalog (prevent concurrent pins).
2) Pin lyra-7b -> lyra-7b-v1 (catalog entry change).
3) Trigger canary routing: 2% traffic to new pin for 10 minutes.
4) Priya runs smoke + perf checks and posts results.
5) If green, ramp to 20% for 15 minutes, final toggle to 100%.
6) If any check fails, rollback: revert pin to previous model (phoenix-4b-pin-20260301) and run post-rollback smoke.
Alex Chen: Rollback command (what I'll run if needed):
```bash
rwdctl catalog pin set --model lyra-7b --pin phoenix-4b-pin-20260301 --env staging --reason "rollback after canary"
```
Priya Iyer: Quick checklist I'll report back in-thread after the 10m canary:
- quality spot-checks (10 prompts)
- log-check: exceptions, rejections, truncation
- latency histogram (P50/P95)
- GPU mem / OOMs
- token cost sanity check
Priya Iyer: Example smoke request (to use in script):
```json
{"model":"lyra-7b-v1","input":"Summarize: The quarterly earnings...","generation_config":{"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.95,"max_tokens":128}}
```
Theo Park: I'll also put a short alert rule for model-level error increase (baseline 0.12%). If it drifts above 0.6% in the first 10 min, I'll flag it.
Maria G.: Can we confirm who will post the final "all clear" in the channel when we hit 100%? Also who owns the post-rollback incident doc if we need it?
Alex Chen: I'll post the deploy events and outcome. If we rollback, Theo, can you draft the initial rollback note? I can add timeline.
Theo Park: Yep I can start the rollback doc and ping SRE/Support for follow-ups.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: catalog-pin/lyra-7b-v1 started by alex_chen at 2026-04-02T14:00:05Z.
Priya Iyer: OK ready. I'll run the smoke script as soon as canary flips and paste a short table of results here.
SRE Oncall: I'll watch infra and tracer. If I see sustained errors, I'll escalate to oncall-sre and post a pager note.
Maria G.: Thanks — looks like we're aligned. I'll block the 14:00 UTC slot on calendar and post a short runbook in the thread before the deploy. :white_check_mark:
